title: Complex Author Contribution Peaks
scenario: Find authors whose total article view count in a rolling 7-day period is in the 99th percentile of all authors, calculated using a sliding range frame.
tableSchema: articles (author_id INT, article_id INT), page_views (article_id INT, view_date DATE, views_count INT)
correctQuery: SELECT author_id FROM (SELECT author_id, SUM(views_count) OVER(PARTITION BY author_id ORDER BY view_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '7 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as rolling_sum FROM articles JOIN page_views USING (article_id)) t WHERE rolling_sum > (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rolling_sum) FROM (SELECT SUM(views_count) OVER(PARTITION BY author_id ORDER BY view_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '7 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as rolling_sum FROM articles JOIN page_views USING (article_id)) t2);
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE articles (author_id INT, article_id INT); CREATE TABLE page_views (article_id INT, view_date DATE, views_count INT);
